$comment: plan.md §9 Task 6.19. Every directory under packages/ is a target or listed in notTargets; the test fails otherwise. A target's mode (and the compiler's entry) come from its own stator.config.json. entries names a directory whose *.ts files are each a target; without it the config's entry is the target.

notTargets.packages/compiler-zig: the compiler's Zig port, built by zig; Stator does not compile Zig
notTargets.packages/interpreter: the interpreter, in Zig, built by zig into libjsrt_interp.a; Stator links it, it does not compile it
notTargets.packages/jstext: Zig text helpers stator-ts and the Zig compiler share; built by zig, not by Stator
notTargets.packages/runtime: C and Zig, built by clang and zig; Stator links it, it does not compile it
notTargets.packages/transpiler: stator-ts, the Zig TypeScript checker the Zig compiler builds on; built by zig, not by Stator
notTargets.packages/tests: test harnesses for the pinned Node, not code written for Stator to compile
notTargets.packages/vite-stator: a Vite plugin and the bundler adapter: they run inside Vite on Node at build time, and the compiler loads them by name, never compiles them
